summary: Opt-in Contender rules from Mendon's Lion vs Dragon game and his notes on it (2026-11-10): ringkeep (keep a Ring in hand rather than discard it for a draw-only ability); equipfirst (equip Followers/Items in its own Action phase before draws, Lobbying or the Favor); pressbody (while ahead on Provinces, Force and Personalities, a Holding beyond mbH=2 waits for an affordable Personality; otherwise the economy rules decide); killthreat (an enemy Personality with a printed destroy ability is the first target, and a destroying battle effect on it outranks Force-only actions); milbody (superseded by pressbody, kept for comparison). Card-agnostic; none is default.
